response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, versatile senior engineer with deep open-source involvement, Linux experience, and broad full-stack expertise, but he falls short on two critical requirements for this executive-level role: German proficiency is listed as Basic against a hard C1 minimum, and his career shows individual-contributor and founder work rather than formal leadership of teams, client-facing consulting, or technical project management. UML, requirements management, and security/compliance experience are also not evidenced.
strengths: Deep open-source and Linux background, including founding and maintaining an OSS geo-data platform (GISCollective)
Extensive senior-level engineering experience across web, backend, embedded, and high-performance systems
Proven mentoring and knowledge-sharing track record via workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German is only Basic; the role requires minimum C1, which is likely a disqualifier
No formal team-leadership, consulting, or technical project-management roles despite senior titles
No demonstrated UML, requirements management, or IT security/risk/compliance experience
